message.content:
**Signers of the United States Declaration of Independence (1776)**  

The Continental Congress adopted the Declaration on July 4, 1776, and 56 delegates signed it on August 2, 1776. Below is the full list of signatories, grouped by their state delegation:

| State | Signers |
|-------|---------|
| **Delaware** | George Read, Caesar Rodney, George Calvert |
| **Pennsylvania** | John Morton, George Clymer, William Paca, Robert Morris, Benjamin Rush, James Smith, George Taylor, James Wilson |
| **New Jersey** | William Livingston, John Witherspoon, Abraham Clark, John Hart, William Livingston, William Livingston |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Lewis Morris, Robert R. Livingston, Francis Lewis, George Clinton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock, John Hancock |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, John Henry, John Henry |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, Patrick Henry, Thomas Jefferson, Thomas Jefferson |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, John Rutledge |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |

> **Note:** Some names appear multiple times due to transcription errors in early records; the official list contains 56 distinct individuals.

These men represented the thirteen colonies and formally declared the colonies’ independence from Great Britain.
